title: Finite-domain continuation search for the QS1 quasi-steady manifold
purpose: Re-test the unchanged QS1 quasi-steady physical manifold using a deterministic root-search construction that brackets only through finite physically admissible profile evaluations, then evaluate exposed B01 development trajectories only if preflight succeeds.

predecessor.D6_failure: fixed extreme endpoints were not physically admissible
preserved_from_D6: steady profile ODE dh/dy=q/K(h)-1 and dStorage/dy=theta(h)
no clipping, dynamic substeps or full-order fallback

profile_integrator.physical_requirement: every RK4 stage and endpoint must have finite h<0, theta_r<theta(h)<theta_s, and finite K(h)>0
profile_integrator.invalid_profile: return INVALID, never clip or extrapolate

root_search_common.exact_root_rule: a finite candidate with residual exactly 0.0 is accepted
root_search_common.bracket_rule: only two neighboring finite candidates in the ordered candidate set may bracket a root; an INVALID point breaks adjacency and cannot be jumped over
root_search_common.bracket_selection: if multiple valid sign-change brackets exist, choose the one whose midpoint is closest to the deterministic state-derived center; ties choose the lower ordered interval
root_search_common.midpoint_invalid_rule: fail closed for that manifold evaluation
root_search_common.root_output: after 64 iterations use midpoint of final finite sign bracket and re-evaluate profile

prescribed_bottom_head_search.continuation_candidates: q_center plus and minus (Ksat/1024)*2^k for k=0..10, clipped to [-Ksat,+Ksat], together with q_center and unique clipped domain limits
prescribed_bottom_head_search.evaluation_order: construct all unique candidates first, sort ascending q, evaluate independently
prescribed_bottom_head_search.sign_bracket: apply root_search_common to neighboring finite candidates only

prescribed_bottom_flux_search.continuation_candidates: h_center plus multiplicative suction continuation: suction=abs(h_center)*2^(j/4) for integer j=-80..80, clipped to [1e-8,1e6], plus unique domain limits
prescribed_bottom_flux_search.evaluation_order: construct all unique h candidates first, sort ascending h, evaluate independently
prescribed_bottom_flux_search.sign_bracket: apply root_search_common to neighboring finite candidates only

requirements: each case finds a finite bracket or exact root
each returned profile is physically admissible
equilibrium prescribed-flux case reproduces initial storage within the fixed RK4 integration result, with no fitted correction
preflight.on_failure: close D7 preflight no-go; do not evaluate trajectories

dynamic_candidate.predictor_and_corrector: each stage invokes the D7 finite-domain manifold search appropriate to the bottom-boundary mode
dynamic_candidate.terminal_profile: reconstructed by the same final-state manifold solution
dynamic_candidate.upper_lower_storage: integrate terminal profile over upper/lower 80 cm

comparators.D5_L2_IMC: closed no-go; retained only as diagnostic predecessor, not the positive threshold comparator

integrity_kill: dynamic root search has no valid finite adjacent sign bracket
any clipping, fitted correction, adaptive dynamic substep or full-order fallback
positive_rule: and QS1 improves on R2 on at least one declared fidelity view
balance view: total-storage RMSE and cumulative-bottom-exchange RMSE both <= R2
or transient view: terminal bottom-flux RMSE <= R2 and sign-error count <= R2

computational_boundary.if_positive: tabulation/interpolation becomes a separate preregistered acceleration workunit
computational_boundary.if_negative: do not tabulate a hydrologically dominated manifold
